The Mortgaged Property is comprised of a 1,054-unit self-storage facility in Roselle, NJ. The borrower entered into a lease with Consolidated Rail Corporation (Conrail) commencing June 22, 2017 for an unimproved strip of land at the rear of the Mortgaged Property for overflow parking. The lease is self-renewing for 1-year periods but is terminable by either party with 30 days’ notice. Because the lease prohibits leasehold financing, the Conrail-leased area is excluded as security for the Mortgage Loan. The appraisal obtained in connection with loan origination did not attribute any value to the Conrail-leased area, nor is such area otherwise necessary for zoning compliance. The Mortgage Loan documents require that the borrower exercise commercially reasonable efforts to have Conrail amend the lease to permit leasehold financing, and to include the Conrail leased space as part of the Mortgaged Property.
